name: @pipeworx/mcp-california-code

tools.name: ca_code_section
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the California Codes — California state statutes — by citation. "Penal Code 187" is code "PEN", section "187". Returns the statutory text, where it sits in the code, and when it was last amended. Keyless. Use for "what does California Penal Code 187 say", "text of California Civil Code 1542", or to check a California statute a contract or case relies on.

code.description: California code abbreviation, e.g. "PEN" (Penal), "CIV" (Civil), "VEH" (Vehicle), "LAB" (Labor). Call ca_codes to see all 29.

section.description: Section number as cited, e.g. "187" or "1542". Subdivisions like "187(a)" are not separate documents — pass the section.

tools.name: ca_codes
tools.description: List the 29 California codes with their subjects — Penal Code is PEN, Vehicle Code is VEH, Labor Code is LAB, and so on. Keyless. Use when you know the subject area but not which code governs it, before calling ca_code_section.

subject.description: Optional subject to filter by, e.g. "divorce", "wages", "DUI".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-california-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the california-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
